name: Proof
description: Proof is a transaction platform for identity verification, electronic signatures, and remote online notarization. Organizations use its Business and Real Estate APIs to create, monitor, and complete legally significant document workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Proof organization with a customer-owned Full Access API key. Agents can list one page of ten redacted Business API transaction-status summaries and inspect one exact transaction status; people, identities, notaries, documents, messages, links, downloads, Real Estate API, child organizations, writes, pagination, and raw API access are blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: PROOF_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Proof Full Access API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: An organization admin creates a customer-owned Full Access key in Proof Settings. Relay encrypts it and uses only the two bounded read tools.

capabilities.label: List transaction status
capabilities.description: List at most ten transaction status summaries without people, documents, or access links.

capabilities.label: Read transaction status
capabilities.description: Read one exact transaction status summary without people, documents, or access links.

allowed.label: List Proof transactions
allowed.description: List at most ten bounded transaction status summaries from the connected Proof organization.

allowed.label: Get Proof transaction
allowed.description: Read one exact transaction's bounded status summary by Proof transaction ID.

blocked.label: Expose private transaction data
blocked.description: Signer, notary, identity, contact, document, annotation, message, access-link, audit-trail, and presigned-URL data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Proof transactions
blocked.description: Creating, activating, updating, deleting, sending, signing, verifying, notarizing, downloading, and webhook administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Proof access
blocked.description: Real Estate API, child-organization traversal, pagination, arbitrary filters, raw API paths, redirects, and bulk export are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Run the two bounded status reads; private transaction data and all mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted customer-owned API key server-side and mounts exactly two fixed-origin bounded read tools.
Railway attaches the encrypted customer-owned API key server-side and mounts exactly two fixed-origin bounded read tools.

providerSetup.blocker: A Proof Business account and organization-admin-created Full Access API key are required. No authorized credentials, paid account, or Fairfax test organization is available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Proof organization admin must create a restricted-purpose Full Access key and connect it through Relay. Then validate bounded status reads, redaction, rate behavior, credential replacement, disconnect, post-disconnect denial, and Notarize alias convergence in Fairfax before any live use.

evidence.supports: Proof documents its Business and Real Estate transaction APIs for identity verification, eSign, and notarization.
Proof documents customer-created Full Access and Client Only API keys, fixed ApiKey authentication, paid-plan constraints, and separate Fairfax credentials.
Proof documents GET /v1/transactions, status filtering, and limit/offset pagination for Business API transactions.
Proof documents GET /v1/transactions/{id} for one exact transaction.
Proof recommends api.proof.com for new integrations while retaining api.notarize.com with the same credentials, supporting one canonical Proof identity with a Notarize alias.
